title: GOV-0021: research conclusion integrity and traceability are not enforced (RSR-004)
problem:
## Observed
After RSR-002/003, ten of the eighteen research controls are enforced, but a record's conclusion can still be internally inconsistent: a record can carry `disposition: RESEARCH_SUFFICIENT` while `state: EVIDENCE_COLLECTING`; a claim can cite `contradicting_sources` with no `contradictions[]` entry recording it (buried, not preserved — RSR-I04); a `MORE_RESEARCH_REQUIRED` record can name a downstream `work_package_id` as if insufficient research authorised implementation; and a named `downstream.decision_id`/`work_package_id` need not resolve, so the Issue → demand → research → decision → work package chain cannot be reconstructed.

## Expected
`badf_gate.py research` enforces: a disposition other than `RESEARCH_BLOCKED` requires `state == RECONCILED` (control 16); a `CHALLENGED` state requires a council; a claim with contradicting sources is recorded in `contradictions[]`, whose refs resolve (control 8); only `RESEARCH_SUFFICIENT` may name a downstream work package (control 15); the `demand` resolves, a named decision resolves and governs the named work package, and a named work package has a record (control 18).

## Evidence
`grep -n "downstream" scripts/badf_gate.py` → `validate_research_record` never reads `downstream`, `state`, or `contradictions` beyond the schema on `main` at `bcb9d6d`.

## Unknowns
None. Controls 3 (baseline git-resolution — needs a repository-research subskill), 6 (source-digest staleness), and 17 (`evidence_digest` recomputation) need machinery beyond a record check and are separate later WPs; `badf-research` stays `DESIGNED` until all 18 pass.

## Proposed work package
`BADF-WP-0038` (RSR-004). Controls 8, 15, 16, 18 in `validate_research_record`; tests + mutation. C2. Brings 14 of 18 to enforced.
